evals.prompt: Create an HCS-14 registry topic on Hedera testnet, generate a UAID for an agent named 'Analysis Bot' with skills [0, 7] using the AID method, create an HCS-11 profile topic, submit the profile, and register the agent on the registry topic. Write the full TypeScript script using @hiero-ledger/sdk.
evals.expected_output: A complete TypeScript script that creates a registry topic, generates a UAID via SHA-384 hash of canonical agent data, creates a profile topic, submits an HCS-11 profile, and submits an HCS-2 register operation to the registry topic.

checks.name: creates-registry-topic
checks.description: Uses TopicCreateTransaction to create the registry topic

checks.name: generates-uaid
checks.description: Generates a UAID using SHA-384 hashing
checks.rubric: The output generates a UAID by computing a SHA-384 hash of canonical agent data and encoding it (e.g. using createHash('sha384') or a standards SDK call)

checks.name: canonical-agent-data
checks.description: Uses the six canonical agent data fields for the AID hash

checks.name: submits-profile
checks.description: Uses TopicMessageSubmitTransaction to submit the HCS-11 profile

checks.name: hcs-2-register-op
checks.description: Submits an HCS-2 register operation to the registry topic
checks.rubric: The output submits a JSON message with p: 'hcs-2' and op: 'register' to the registry topic

checks.name: includes-uaid-in-profile
checks.description: Includes the UAID in the HCS-11 profile or registration memo

checks.name: json-messages
checks.description: Serializes structured JSON messages for topic submission

evals.prompt: Write a TypeScript script that discovers agents registered to an HCS-14 registry topic by reading messages from the Hedera Mirror Node REST API. Parse HCS-2 register operations, extract UAIDs from memos, and resolve each agent's HCS-11 profile from its profile topic.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript script that fetches messages from the Mirror Node REST API, decodes base64 messages, parses HCS-2 operations, extracts UAIDs, and resolves HCS-11 profiles by reading profile topics.

checks.name: uses-mirror-node-api
checks.description: Queries the Mirror Node REST API for topic messages

checks.name: base64-decodes
checks.description: Base64-decodes the message field before parsing JSON
checks.rubric: The output decodes the base64-encoded message field from the mirror node response before parsing JSON

checks.name: parses-hcs-2-ops
checks.description: Parses HCS-2 operations from the decoded messages

checks.name: handles-pagination
checks.description: Follows pagination links to get all messages
checks.rubric: The output follows pagination links (links.next) to retrieve all messages from the topic

checks.name: extracts-uaid
checks.description: Extracts or references UAIDs from registration memos

checks.name: resolves-profile
checks.description: Resolves agent profiles from their profile topic IDs

evals.prompt: Explain how HCS-14 agent identity on Hedera bridges to ERC-8004 on EVM chains. What are the mapping points between UAIDs and ERC-8004 agent registries, and how should cross-chain agent identity and x402 payment evidence be handled?
evals.expected_output: An explanation covering the UAID to ERC-8004 agentRegistry mapping, HCS-2 topic to ERC-721 identity registry mapping, cross-registration via the registrations array, and the principle that identity/discovery, payment evidence (x402), and trust/reputation should be kept as separate concerns.

checks.name: maps-uaid-to-agentregistry
checks.description: Maps UAIDs to ERC-8004 agentRegistry / agentId format

checks.name: cross-registration
checks.description: Explains cross-registration between HCS-14 and ERC-8004

checks.name: separates-concerns
checks.description: States that identity, x402 payment evidence, and trust/reputation are separate concerns
checks.rubric: The output explains that identity registration/discovery, x402 payment evidence, and trust/reputation computation are kept as separate concerns (payment evidence is not embedded in the registry)

checks.name: skills-alignment
checks.description: Mentions skill ID alignment between HCS-14 and ERC-8004
